_comment: Single source of truth for every price, the launch end date and every build time on the site. build.py reads this file; pages never contain a price. Amounts are whole rupees. After launch_end, the build renders standard prices only and drops the launch label and strike-through. Totals are never written here: pack prices and quotes are worked out from these rules, the same way in build.py and in pricing.js.
_rules: The first system you pick is at its full price. Each further system is at its bundle rate, or at the related add-on rate when it builds on one you're already paying for. Setups are at their own price, or the setup add-on rate alongside a related system. An add-on always rides on a system you're paying for that costs at least as much on its own, never on another add-on or on a setup. A service marked never_addon (the website) is always a main build.
_related: Pairs that share groundwork, so the second one costs the add-on rate. Pairs of two systems work either way round. A setup pairs with the systems listed beside it.
_packs: Named combinations the bundle builder suggests. Their prices are worked out from the rules above, never written down.
included_year_one: Small changes and fixes (text, prices, hours, photos)
usage_note: Messages your business starts on WhatsApp (reminders, follow-ups) carry small Meta fees, and phone services need a phone line — both billed at cost. Chats your customers start cost nothing extra.
